video_caption: The video opens with a close-up view of various Halloween masks hanging on a black pegboard in what appears to be a store. A gory zombie mask with exposed red flesh, white eyes, and rotten teeth is prominent, alongside a black furry dog or wolf mask with an open mouth and yellow eyes, and a partially visible white skull mask. The scene transitions to another display of masks, featuring a central burlap-like mask with horns resembling a scarecrow or cow, flanked by a menacing clown mask with red hair on the left and a grey werewolf mask with sharp teeth on the right. Another shot focuses on the gory zombie mask from before, showing its decaying details, with a red devil mask peeking from the left. Subsequently, a smooth, pale, faceless mask with dark, almond-shaped eye holes is displayed, labeled as a "SILENT STALKER MASK" on its packaging, with other masks like a clown, a skull, and the burlap cow visible in the background. The video then cuts to an exterior shot of a bright blue "TOYS 'Я' US" store with colorful lettering and a yellow star, under a blue sky with white clouds, as a person in a black t-shirt walks towards the entrance. Abruptly, the store transforms into "SPIRIT HALLOWEEN," with a new orange and black banner, the sky turns dark with a large glowing full moon, and oversized animated Halloween characters – a red-haired clown, a grim reaper with skeletal hands reaching out from the roof, and another grim reaper – appear around and above the building, accompanied by spooky sound effects and a voice saying, "You were told to stay away!" followed by a scream and "What are those?". Finally, the video transitions to an outro screen featuring a logo of a cartoon man in a red plaid shirt and baseball cap, holding a bloody knife and a jack-o'-lantern, set against a blue circle with a full moon and a spooky house. The text "THAT NATE GUY" and "@ YOUTUBE" frames the logo. Below, animated YouTube elements appear: a grey "thumbs up" icon turns blue and then displays "4K," a red "Subscribe" button changes to grey and says "Subscribed," and a grey notification bell turns red, followed by the text "THANK YOU!" with small skulls.

The video opens with a close-up of a smiling man with a red beard, wearing a black t-shirt that reads "CLASSIC HORROR MOVIE SLASHER" at the bottom, looking directly at the camera. The camera then smoothly pans up and out, revealing a wide shot of a beige strip mall building under a clear blue sky. A large, prominent orange and black sign for "Spirit Halloween" with a black cat on a broomstick logo is visible above the main entrance. Another sign for "Michaels" is seen further down the building to the right. The camera slowly zooms in on the "Spirit Halloween" store's entrance, which features glass doors and windows adorned with Halloween-themed decorations and banners. A "NOW OPEN" sign in yellow text is visible on the door. Several people, including a child in a pink outfit, are seen entering and exiting the store, and cars are parked in the sunny parking lot in front of the building.

The video showcases a large, grey-toned animatronic skeleton display inside a Spirit Halloween store, standing on a base decorated with chains, bricks, and a metal grate, with a red tiled floor in front; the skeleton, with glowing blue eyes, mummified hands, and skeletal feet, is making ghoulish sounds but not moving, positioned before a distressed "Spirit Halloween Factory" sign (English: "Spirit Halloween Factory") which serves as a thematic backdrop to the Halloween decorations. The camera captures various close-ups of the animatronic's features, including its zombie-like face and details of the base, before transitioning to a man wearing a black t-shirt and a face mask with Michael Myers' image, speaking and pointing towards the animatronic, with other shoppers visible in the background browsing merchandise.

In this video segment, a person with long dark hair, wearing a light-colored jacket and dark pants, walks on a reddish-brown tiled floor towards the right side of the frame. They approach a stack of four large, identical cardboard boxes, which are prominently displayed against a large window. The boxes are green with black vertical stripes and feature an image of the character Beetlejuice, along with the text "BEETLEJUICE" in white lettering. The person gestures towards the boxes and touches one of the top boxes. Through the large window behind the boxes, a sunny outdoor scene is visible, including a parking lot with cars and another person walking with a small child. On the far left, a black merchandise display stand with various smaller items is partially visible.

The video captures an indoor scene, likely within a Spirit Halloween store, featuring a red tiled floor and a large window that looks out onto a sunlit parking lot with several vehicles. In the foreground, various Halloween animatronic boxes are displayed. On the right, two large black boxes are stacked vertically, prominently labeled "Spirit Halloween BAPHOMET" and showcasing an image of a horned, cloaked figure holding a scythe. The text on the top box details the animatronic's features: "Body and head pivots left and right! Right arm moves back and forth! LED light up eyes and moving mouth! Says frightening phrases! Stands 7.55 Feet Tall!" To the left of these, two smaller black boxes are stacked, both featuring "Spirit Halloween Ghost Face" and an image of the Ghost Face character from the *Scream* franchise. Further left on the floor, two more black boxes are seen, one with an image of a clown, and both adorned with yellow price tags indicating "REDUCED PRICE NOW ONLY $115.00" and "$150.00." A person's hand, wearing a ring, briefly enters the frame around 0:13, gesturing towards the stacked Ghost Face boxes. A display stand with various small items and a picture of Beetlejuice is partially visible to the right of the Baphomet boxes.

The video opens with a shot of a red-tiled floor and a large window in the background, revealing daylight outside. On the floor, positioned against the window, are two large black cardboard boxes, likely containing Halloween animatronics from Spirit Halloween. The box on the right features an image of a clown-like figure named "Henry Hustle" and has a prominent yellow sticker with red text that reads, "REDUCED PRICE! NOW ONLY $115.00" (Original price: "$229.99"). Below, the "REASON REDUCED" is stated as "Head sits sideways, Does not pop up correctly." The box on the left, labeled "Little Daisy & The Maestro," displays an image of a tall figure holding a small puppet-like figure on strings. This box also has a yellow "REDUCED PRICE! NOW ONLY" sticker, showing "$150.00" (Original price: "$299.99"). The "REASON REDUCED" for this item is "Girl's neck is broken." A person, identifiable by their left arm and hand wearing a purple bracelet, is shown pointing at the price details on both boxes, initially on "Henry Hustle" and then on "Little Daisy & The Maestro," lifting the flap of the latter box slightly.

The video opens with a person in a white t-shirt and white sneakers holding a "Spirit Halloween EVELYN LEECH" animatronic box, which displays images of a creepy, zombie-like head with glowing yellow eyes, captioned "Arms move forward to show you a closer look of her Groom's head," and another image of a ghost-like figure, all on a red tiled floor with a bright window in the background. The camera then shifts to a black pegboard display where the person's hand points out and picks up several "Pop! Hocus Pocus 773 BILLY BUTCHERSON" vinyl figures, showing six of them, followed by a "Pop! Trick 'r Treat 1036 SAM" Spirit Exclusive figure next to "SAM'S RULES OF HALLOWEEN" books. The person then displays two "Pop! Killer Klowns 922 SHORTY" figures and two "Pop! Fortnite 432 LOVE RANGER" figures, with the text "VINYL FIGURE / FIGURINE EN VINYLE / FIGURA DE VINIL" visible on the box. Finally, the camera moves through the Halloween store, revealing an elaborate "FACTORY SHOWROOM" display resembling a dilapidated brick building with a green-paned window and red-and-black caution tape, flanked by shelves packed with various Halloween costumes, masks (including clown and skull masks), and yellow bat-shaped accessories, all resting on the red tiled floor.

The video begins with a close-up of a Halloween display, showing a wooden wall background and a light grey floor covered with scattered faux bricks in red and grey, a long metal chain, and a "Twisty Clowns" clown mask package. A hand points at the chain. The scene transitions to an aisle with a red tiled floor, displaying yellow foam clubs with red stripes, labeled with "Twisty Clowns" and a black T-shirt featuring "KILLER KLOWNS FROM OUTER SPACE" branding. Next, a black display rack showcases a "Ghost face Light Up Ghost Face" costume package and a "Ghost Face™ Light Up Mask" which a hand activates, causing its mouth to glow red. The video then shows a man wearing a black t-shirt and a dark face mask with a colorful Michael Myers graphic, talking and looking around the store. Finally, a wide shot of a store aisle with a red tiled floor reveals a large stack of "ASTRONAUT HELMET" boxes, alongside other costume boxes including a "SPIRIT HALLOWEEN DISPOSABLE DUMMY PROP" and another "Ghost face" costume.

The video opens with a close-up of a hand pointing at "ASTRONAUT HELMET" boxes, noting different colored visors and a black helmet, before panning to an aisle filled with various Halloween props in boxes. These include a "Ghostface" prop, a "SPIRIT POSABLE DUMMY PROP," a "CHUCKY GREETER," an "EMPTY SOUL GIRL ON A SWING," and a "CREEPY CRIMSON GIRL ON A SWING," as well as a "MICHAEL MYERS GREETER." The camera then focuses on a man with a short beard and blue eyes, wearing a black t-shirt and a face mask depicting Michael Myers, who scans the store. The scene transitions to a large, dilapidated-looking structure labeled "HALLOWEEN FACTORY" with a warning sign (DANGER SHOCK HAZARD). The man points to the "HALLOWEEN FACTORY" sign, revealing the high industrial ceiling of the store. He then shows the interior of the factory display, filled with scattered faux bricks, chains, some small "clipboards" or similar objects, and what looks like debris or fake bugs on the floor. More details of the distressed walls, broken bricks, and metal pipes are visible. Finally, the camera shows two skull props within the factory setup and then pans across an aisle filled with numerous Halloween decorations and props, such as skeletal figures and gravestones, all displayed on black shelving against a red tiled floor.

The video showcases various Halloween merchandise inside a Spirit Halloween store, starting with stacked boxes of "Trick r Treat SAM GROUNDBREAKER" figures visible on a red-tiled floor. A hand, belonging to a person wearing a white wristband, then points to a "Trick r Treat LIGHT UP WAGON" display, featuring a red wagon with "Trick r Treat" written on it and orange light-up pumpkins. The camera pans to a shelf where two "PENNYWISE SIDE STEPPER" figures are displayed in their boxes; the person activates both figures, whose eyes glow yellow as they move and make sounds, before deactivating them. Following this, a "SCARY GARGOYLE PATHWAY MARKERS" set, featuring an illuminated gargoyle, is shown, then a "BURNING SKULL PATHWAY MARKERS" set with two red and black skull lights. A shelf displaying several gray rat figures with red eyes is briefly featured. The hand then picks up a "Spirit Halloween Candle Holder" package, revealing three skull-shaped candle holders designed to depict "hear no evil, see no evil, speak no evil" by having skeletal hands covering their ears, eyes, and mouth, respectively. The video concludes with a close-up of a bald person with a beard, wearing a black t-shirt and a black face mask featuring Michael Myers from the Halloween franchise, looking at the camera and smiling, with more Halloween merchandise visible in the background.

The video segment shows a person's hand interacting with various Halloween-themed merchandise boxes on a red tiled floor, likely in a store. From 00:05, the hand points to a yellow "REDUCED PRICE!" sign attached to a black box. The sign reads "NOW ONLY $100.00", with an "ORIGINAL PRICE: $199.99". The "ITEM NAME" is "Night Crawler", and the "REASON REDUCED" states "Catches when going back down". Small text at the bottom reads "REDUCED PRICE APPLIES TO THIS ITEM ONLY. SOLD 'AS IS' ALL SALES FINAL." The hand then gestures away from the box. At 00:11, the hand points to another yellow "REDUCED PRICE!" sign, this time for "The Hauntress" box. This item is "NOW ONLY $65.00", down from an "ORIGINAL PRICE: $129.99", and the "REASON REDUCED" is "Does not work". The hand moves away again. From 00:18, the hand picks up a black box labeled "DECAYING ZOMBIE GROUND-BREAKER" and places it back down, revealing two more similar boxes behind it. Finally, at 00:22, the hand picks up a "CRACKED SKULL ZOMBIE GROUNDBREAKER" box and presses a button on its side, causing the skull's eyes inside the clear plastic window to glow bright green, indicating it works.

The video opens with a close-up of three identical "IT" themed red balloon decorations, each held by a white, disembodied hand, inside clear boxes. The scene then transitions to a display of "FLAMING PUMPKIN" decorations, which appear to be carved pumpkins with tall, flickering flames simulated at the top, and a hand points to one of the pumpkins. Next, a row of zombie-like figures is shown, some with arrows protruding from their heads and one with barbed wire wrapped around its face, and a hand gestures towards them. The video then pans across an aisle filled with various Halloween costumes and animatronics, including multiple scary clowns, zombies, and other monstrous figures hanging on racks, with a red floor visible beneath them. Finally, the camera focuses on a white-haired, pale-faced figure with dark streaked eyes, and a hand gently touches its hair, before revealing a green Frankenstein's monster head and another figure in yellow and black stripes nearby.

The video opens in a Spirit Halloween store, showcasing various decorations, starting with a "Kicking Clown" featuring a white face, green hair, red nose, and glowing yellow eyes, hanging above a rainbow-striped lower body. A hand with a white wristband then activates a "Vintage Frankenstein" decoration with a green face, purple scars, and yellow light-up eyes; its tag is visible, reading "Spirit Halloween Hanging Vintage Monster 1 pc". The same hand then interacts with a "Vintage Devil" decoration, which has a red face, horns, and yellow light-up eyes, with its tag indicating "Spirit Halloween Hanging Vintage Devil 1 pc". Next, a "Scary Shaking Nurse" decoration with a white, gaunt face, dark eye sockets, red lips, and a nurse's cap with a red cross is shown, its eyes lighting up blue. The video briefly shifts to a person wearing a black t-shirt and a Michael Myers-themed face mask, looking at the camera from within the store. Returning to the decorations, the hand points first at the "Kicking Clown" and then at a gory, severed arm held by another decoration nearby, revealing the "Spirit Kicking Clown" tag. The camera then pans to two large, gray rat decorations with glowing red eyes on a shelf, with pumpkins and skeletal hands in the background. The video concludes with a view down a store aisle with red flooring and merchandise-filled shelves, and the hand points to a stack of boxes labeled "Spirit Brown Jumping Spider".

The video begins inside a Spirit Halloween store, showing aisles filled with masks, costumes, and props. A man in a grey shirt walks down an aisle, and the camera focuses on a display of prop knives, including a "Malakai knife from Children of the Corn" and a "Bloody Blade" knife, which the man picks up and examines. The camera then pans across various scary masks, highlighting a black bull mask, a gruesome zombie mask, a "Silent Stalker Mask," and others. The man then picks up a white "Deluxe Phantom Mask," noting someone had previously asked about it. He points to a "Jolly Wally Mask" among other clown masks, expressing his interest. Next, the man places several small stickers on the floor near a large skeletal prop under a "Halloween Factory" sign. He then appears on screen, a bald man with a red beard wearing a black t-shirt, speaking to the camera outside the "Spirit Halloween" store (2300A, OPEN!), mentioning his purchases and saying goodbye to "the wiener" as the camera pans across the parking lot to a Texas Roadhouse restaurant. The video concludes with a lightning effect transition to an animated outro featuring a cartoon man with a knife and pumpkin, with text "THAT NATE GUY YOUTUBE" and prompts to "Subscribe," "Like," and "Thank You!" appearing.
